name: cfg-always-on-trigger
about: alwaysOn 段里没比过的键（always-on/config/parseAlwaysOnConfig.ts:51-330，闸门 always-on/runtime/DiscoveryGates.ts:27-80）：已移除的 alwaysOn.enabled / discovery / plan / cron / dormancy / workspace / execution、trigger.enabled、projects.<root>.sessionKey / workspace 只给 ALWAYS_ON_FIELD_REMOVED 警告；trigger.cooldownMinutes / dailyBudget / heartbeatStaleSeconds / recentUserMsgMinutes / preferChannel 的合法值进配置快照；dailyBudget=0 时调度器（3 秒一跳，等约 8 秒）每跳都被 daily_budget 挡住，不发 discovery 请求、不写 always-on 落盘文件。再用 serve 起几份非法取值：数字非法 ALWAYS_ON_NUMBER_INVALID 回落缺省、preferChannel 空串或非字符串 ALWAYS_ON_TRIGGER_PREFER_CHANNEL_INVALID、language 非法、trigger 不是对象 ALWAYS_ON_TRIGGER_INVALID（致命）、项目值不是对象 ALWAYS_ON_PROJECT_INVALID（致命）。
config:
schemaVersion: 1
agent:
  model: bbx/deterministic
  maxContextTokens: 65536
  maxOutputTokens: 8192
model:
  providers:
    bbx:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      models:
        deterministic:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
telemetry:
  enabled: false
alwaysOn:
  enabled: true
  language: zh-CN
  discovery: {}
  plan: {maxPlans: 2}
  cron: {}
  dormancy: {idleHours: 1}
  workspace: {provider: git}
  execution: {maxTurns: 3}
  bogusTop: 1
  trigger:
    enabled: true
    tickIntervalMinutes: 0.05
    cooldownMinutes: 0
    dailyBudget: 0
    heartbeatStaleSeconds: 30
    recentUserMsgMinutes: 0
    preferChannel: feishu
  projects:
    {HOME}/work/alpha:
      enabled: true
      sessionKey: s-fixed
      workspace: {provider: copy}
      bogus: 1
